description: Skip-turn recovery: +0.5 energy (+1.5 with an intact shelter in the region), once per tick, never above your max energy. NOTE: passive decay still runs on a tick you rest (1/tick base plus 0.15 per trained level, the total halved by an intact shelter in the region), so with no trained levels a tick spent resting nets -0.5 energy without a shelter and +1 with one, or less when your max energy caps the recovery. A shelter decays too: it loses 1 of its 100 hp a tick, and a repair costs wood.
